about: Choroboros demo specification for the v5 portrait film and the 15 s TikTok. Machine-readable twin of film/v5/TREATMENT.md section 3. The audio build renders from this file and the picture reads knob values, engine, core, bypass state and the chip from it. Every time is MASTER time (seconds from the first sample of the owner's master, gapless 48 kHz decode; see film/v5/grid.json).
time_base: master seconds; bar n beat k = 0.4048 + (n-1)*1.621622 + (k-1)*0.405405
units: plugin display units: rate Hz, depth/width/color/mix percent, offset degrees, trim dB. choro-render accepts these directly (e.g. --depth 22%).

inputs.master: /home/user/build/v5/master_src.wav (48 kHz stereo, the song as it is)
inputs.renderer: /home/user/build/choro-render/build/choro-render (called by path; never copied, never committed)

bp.type: Butterworth band-pass, 4th order per edge, zero phase (sosfiltfilt)

BP.why: Only the guitar band is processed. The bottom (bass, kick residue) and the top above 5.5 kHz (cymbal residue in nd) stay dry. We subtract exactly what we feed, so no complementary crossover is needed. In the guitar-alone windows nd = master (drums digitally silent), so the same formula processes the master itself: no path switch anywhere.
null_requirements: Mix 0 render of BP(nd) vs BP(nd): residual < -100 dBFS (proves zero latency/alignment)
out - master is band-limited: energy above 6.5 kHz < -90 dBFS
out - master carries no drum transients: envelope correlation with the fitted drums < 0.05
bypass spans and everything outside demos: bit-identical to the master

fallback_parallel.use_when: BP fails a null requirement or the crash-dense bars 45-52 swirl audibly. wet_only = choro(Mix 100 %) - dry-aligned; g set so the result matches the BP level. Record the choice per demo in the report.

render.per_demo: one render per demo: input = BP(nd) from (t0 - 3.0 s) to (t1 + 0.1 s); automation times = master time - (t0 - 3.0); keep [t0, t1]. Every knob passed explicitly (never the factory profile). --block 128 --preroll 0 --tail 0. Workers <= 2.
render.automation: continuous params sampled from the gesture curve every 10 ms (the picture reads the same curve from this file); hq stepped; trim automated if the renderer accepts it in automation, else applied as the identical gain curve after the render (same numbers shown in the header).

crossfades.engine_on_hit: 20 ms equal-power ending at the hit attack
crossfades.engine_on_bar_line: 20 ms equal-power centred on the bar line
crossfades.bypass_toggle: 10 ms equal-power, midpoint 5 ms before the hit attack

level_match.rule: trim per demo = -(LUFS(out) - LUFS(master)) over the demo's ON span, rounded to 0.1 dB, rendered with --trim (the plug-in's own Output Trim). Then check PER BAR: every full ON bar of out within +-0.5 LU of the same bar of the master, and the demo's integrated loudness within +-0.2 LU. If a bar fails, split the demo at that bar line and give each part its own trim (the header readout changes on that bar line). Record trims in measured.json (see picture_data.measured).
level_match.peaks: No limiter on the song. In each bar, out's true peak must not exceed the master's own true peak in that bar by more than 0.1 dB; if it does, lower that demo's trim in 0.1 dB steps.
level_match.mono: per demo: mono fold-down of the processed guitar band loses at most 0.6 LU more than the dry band's fold-down, and L/R correlation of the processed band stays > +0.1. Width stays 100 %; if a demo fails, lower Depth in 2 % steps and update the readout values in this file.
level_match.on_screen: 'LEVEL MATCHED' is shown only for demos whose per-bar check passed (picture reads measured.json).

picture_data.scope: /home/user/build/v5/audio/scope/ (main) and /home/user/build/v5/audio/scope-tiktok/ (TikTok): index.json + dry.i16 + wet.i16 in the existing scope.js format; v5.sh links them to /data/scope. Format (400 mid/side pairs per frame from 800 samples at 48 kHz, one fixed data gain for both films), aligned to COMPOSITION time (main: master; tiktok: master - 123.648). dry = BP(nd); wet = the guitar band as heard (choro_trim(BP(nd)) inside demos, BP(nd) in bypass and outside demos).
picture_data.meter: /home/user/build/v5/audio/scope[-tiktok]/meter.json (served as /data/scope/meter.json): per frame, the processed band's peak dBFS after trim (drives the top bar's TRIM meter).
picture_data.measured: /home/user/build/v5/audio/scope[-tiktok]/measured.json (served as /data/scope/measured.json): per demo id, trim_db actually used, per-bar LU deltas, pass/fail, mono result.
